reply_text:
I sent Hollis our two notes on these issues in his DM. Neither ticket's current status is posted anywhere I'm allowed to check for him.

1. Salina North Gatehouse Check-In report timeout: this is ticket #4409, from Moss's Central handoff digest dated 2 Jan 2026. It was a recurring timeout at Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake. Hollis flagged it before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan. The digest calls it "Pree's dealer account" and doesn't say who took it over. The same digest also lists ticket #4412, a driver SMS prompt glitch on the overflow lots. I found no later update on either ticket.

2. West yard Door 2 double-booking: on 13 Oct in #central-random, Tobias said Door 2 still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841. Nothing has been posted since, so I pointed Hollis to Tobias.

That chat calls the account "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I'm assuming it's the same account because Marrow Fieldworks changed hands in January, but I didn't say that to Hollis and nothing I found confirms it.

There are no Marrow Fieldworks account files in the share, and I told Hollis so. I only used #central-team, #central-random and public files, all of which Hollis can see.
